incidents.title: auth-service: 401 spike, tokens rejected after signing key rotation
incidents.alert_text: [FIRING] AuthFailuresHigh: 401 rate 63% across api services (threshold 5%). Login succeeds but subsequent API calls are rejected.
incidents.root_cause: Scheduled signing-key rotation started signing tokens with the new key immediately after publishing it, but API services cache the JWKS for 24h, so tokens with the new kid were rejected
incidents.resolution: Switched signing back to the previous key (kid 2026-03-k1); forced a JWKS cache refresh on all services; changed key rotation to publish new keys 48h before using them for signing
failed_attempts: Restarted auth-service pods (the stale JWKS cache was in the consuming services, not auth-service)
Rolled back the latest auth-service deploy (unrelated to the key rotation; no effect)
